_comment: AQE testgen validator holes, reproduced by aqe-repro.mjs (2026-10-29) on a copy of the shop fixture project: tests/fixtures/dsm/shop (dsm.json, code-model.json), tests/fixtures/knowledge/shop/aqe as .claude/skills, config aut-skills app_name Shop, shop/testgen.json. Each run mutates the passing golden run in shop/run (made by make-run.mjs). AQE 0.2.0 results; 0.1.5 gave the same exit and status unless a 0.1.5 key says otherwise.

runs.problem: none: the hand-written Cart run passes
an invented element passes when its name is part of a real one: "Check" is inside "checkout"
runs.change: TC-CART-001 last step: element "Check" on /cart (the DSM has Coupon, checkout, Keep shopping)

runs.problem: UI named in the action text is never checked: only the optional element field is
runs.change: TC-CART-001 last step: no element field; action names an "Apply voucher" button that is not in the DSM

runs.problem: an invented business rule passes when it cites a real file at a line that does not exist, and a skill without a heading
runs.change: TC-CART-002 last step: expected "total drops by 10 percent", evidence code:shop:src/Cart.tsx:9999 (the file is in the code model) and aut:AUT_Shop

runs.problem: a requirement ID passes if the manifest lists it; the manifest is written by the same model, and nothing checks requirements/
runs.change: manifest.requirements gains US-999 (no requirements/ folder at all); TC-CART-003 cites req:US-999

runs.problem: with requirements given as a string, req:US-1 passes because "US-12" contains it
raising hallucination_tolerance in config/testgen.json lets invented elements through, and the run still reports pass
runs.change: config hallucination_tolerance 2; TC-CART-004 and 005 last steps name elements Voucher code and Gift card (not in the DSM)
errors: TC-CART-004 step 4: element "Voucher code" is not on /cart in the DSM (invented UI element?)
TC-CART-005 step 4: element "Gift card" is not on /cart in the DSM (invented UI element?)

runs.problem: a cell starting with = is written as it is into testcases.csv, which a spreadsheet runs as a formula
runs.change: TC-CART-001 title starts with =HYPERLINK(...); testgen render

runs.problem: review.json does not say which DSM it was checked against, and its name says "review" though no person reviewed anything (AQE's pipeline counts it as the reviewed stage)
runs.change: validate the golden run, read review.json

runs.problem: no DSM exits 1 (QAMaster: fail) instead of blocked
